channel.title: The Medical Republic Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Medical Republic Group (medicalrepublic.com.au)

item.title: Managing residual CV risk in patients with ASCVD - Medical Republic
item.description: ASCVD patients remain at high risk, highlighting the need for earlier, intensive LDL-C lowering.

item.title: Closing the Gap sooner rather than later - Medical Republic
item.description: The latest Close the Gap report has laid out where healthcare needs to reform to ensure the best First Nations patient care.

item.title: What if your AI scribe could see as well as hear? - Medical Republic
item.description: It’s just at proof of concept stage, and privacy and hallucination are still of concern, but the benefits are there.

item.title: RACGP on team 12-month referrals, but willing to change - Medical Republic
item.description: Mandated clinical summary exchanges and improved digital interoperability would be enough to get the royal college to back indefinite referrals.

item.title: Your life in the time of the AI dragons: webinar - Medical Republic
item.description: It doesn’t matter what part of health services you’re in, ChatGPT Health, Claude Health, Heidi and Lyrebird will fundamentally change our health system dynamic and how you see and do your work.

item.title: Coming up: Recurrent nasal polyps management – When to refer - Medical Republic
item.description: Nasal polyps are an endpoint of an inflammatory process rather than a standalone disease.

item.title: TGA not concerned about war-caused drug shortages - Medical Republic
item.description: A six month-stockpile is mandated for all PBS medicines, and suppliers must alert the government if they can’t meet those obligations. So far, so good.

item.title: Admin, cost deterring GPs from voluntary assisted dying - Medical Republic
item.description: The lack of a specific Medicare rebate for assisted dying is a major factor preventing GPs from participating.

item.title: The uncomfortable truth about power, silence and accountability in medicine - Medical Republic
item.description: After securing a rare sexual assault conviction against a senior doctor, Dr Dominique Lee says hospitals must confront the power structures that allow harm to continue.

item.title: Money talks, health talks louder: RACGP - Medical Republic
item.description: With the NSW budget set to drop in June, the RACGP has had its say on how health funding should be allocated.
